commands.#comment: THIS SCRIPT WORKS WITH MISSION VERSION AND BUILD EQUAL OR ABOVE TO THE FOLLOWING (DO NOT EDIT)
BUILD OF THIS SCRIPT (DO NOT EDIT): THE MISSION TELLS YOU WHEN IT IS TOO OLD FOR THE MISSION
HPG HEMS RANDOM AND EVERYWHERE: CUSTOM MISSION SCRIPT ------------------------------------------------
0) CREATE A UNIQUE id OF THE SCRIPT (TOP OF THE FILE): REPLACE prototype_3 WITH ANOTHER NAME ---------
ONLY THE EDITABLE AREAS (BASIC, ADVANCED, OBJECTS) ARE MEANT TO BE CHANGED ---------------------------
1) PUT MISSION ID (AS PER CUSTOM MISSION LIST) IN L:CUS_ID_CARD. 999 = INCIDENT OF THE data SECTION --
3) PUT SUBVARIANT (1 to 3, ONLY EFFECTIVE ON FEW ACCIDENTS) IN L:CUS_MISSION_SCENE_VARIANT -----------
NOTE: DISPATCH CODE DIGITS ARE: 1st MISSION ID; 2nd VARIANT; 3rd SUBVARIANT --------------------------
4) PUT ACCIDENT LAT and LON (GOOGLE MAPS FORMAT) IN L:CUS_ACCIDENT LAT and L:CUS_ACCIDENT LON --------
5) PUT (OPTIONAL) STARTING LAT,LON IN THE START LOCATION AT THE TOP OF THE FILE ----------------------
6) SET (OPTIONAL) AMBULANCE / FIRE / POLICE PRESENCE: 0 NOT PRESENT; 1 ON SCENE; 2 ON THE ROAD -------
MISSION SELECTION
ACCIDENT LOCATION
RESCUE VEHICLE PRESENCE
1) L:SKIP_QUERY: 1 = USE THE ACCIDENT COORDINATES (KEEP 1), 0 = THE MISSION SEARCHES A PLACE ---------
2) L:CUS_CARLS_AUTOCONNECT: 1 = CARLS RADIO CONNECTS AT MISSION START --------------------------------
3) L:SKIPIFCLOSE: 1 = SKIP THE MENU IF THE H/C STARTS CLOSE TO THE START LOCATION --------------------
4) L:CUS_USERA LAT / LON: PICK-UP POINT OF MISSIONS 99 TO 102. 0 = ACCIDENT PLACE --------------------
5) L:CUS_RESCUE LAT / LON: GROUND MEETING POINT. 0 = THE MISSION CHOOSES IT --------------------------
6) L:CUS_HOSPITAL LAT / LON: YOUR HOSPITAL, PROPOSED FIRST. 0 = NEAREST. NAME = CUS_HOSPITAL_NAME ----
7) L:CUSVFXA LAT / LON: MOVES THE FIRE / SMOKE EFFECT. 0 = IT STAYS WHERE THE MISSION PUTS IT --------
OPTIONS
PICK-UP AND MEETING POINTS (0 = AUTOMATIC)
CUSTOM HOSPITAL (0 = THE NEAREST ONE IS PROPOSED)
VFX RELOCATION (IF VFX IS PRESENT). Keep it 0 to avoid relocation
OBJECTS (ADVANCED): UP TO 30, ONE BLOCK EACH. DELETE A BLOCK TO REMOVE AN OBJECT, COPY ONE TO ADD ----
title: EXACT MODEL TITLE, AS IN THE aircraft.cfg OF THE OBJECT PACKAGE (CASE AND SPACES MATTER) ------
var1, var2: VAR 1 AND VAR 2 OF THE OBJECT (POSE OR STATE). 0 IF YOU DO NOT KNOW ----------------------
0 = NOWHERE   1 = INJURED HUMAN   2 = INJURED HUMAN 2 (IF ANY)   3 = INJURED HUMAN 3 (IF ANY) ----
4 = THE ACCIDENT PLACE   5 = THE POINT IN aimlat / aimlon   6 = THE PREVIOUS OBJECT OF THIS LIST -
aimlat, aimlon: LATITUDE AND LONGITUDE USED ONLY WHEN aim IS 5 (0 AND 0 OTHERWISE) -------------------
fallback: TITLE USED WHEN title IS NOT INSTALLED. "" = NONE, THE OBJECT IS SIMPLY MISSING ------------
A fallback SHOULD BE A DEFAULT OBJECT (e.g. Airbus H145 Injured Human): USERS MAY LACK YOUR ADD-ONS --
OBJECT 1: Airbus H145 FR Crash TGV
OBJECT 2: Airbus H145 Injured Human
OBJECT 3: Airbus H145 Injured Human 2

OBJECT 5: 30West dazed

FOR SUPER ADVANCED USERS: YOU MAY GO TO THE data SECTION AND CUSTOMIZE THE CUSTOM MISSION (ID 999) ---
